items.title: 1.3 Domain Eukarya ke kingdoms ki khaas khasoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.3, printed pages 7-10 (PDF 10-13).

blocks.text: Eukarya chaar kingdoms par bana hai: Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Is mein tamam eukaryotes aate hain, yani woh jandar (organisms) jin ke cells complex eukaryotic cells hain, jin mein nucleus aur doosre membrane wale organelles hote hain.
1. Kingdom Protista

Kingdom Protista mein woh eukaryotes aate hain jo unicellular (ek cell wale), colonial (cells ki basti), filamentous (dhaage jaise) ya simple multicellular hote hain. Simple multicellular ka matlab hai ke in mein multicellular sex organs (kai cells se bane reproductive organs) nahi hote. Protists teen qisam ke hain.
Kuch protists parasites hain aur bimariyan paida karte hain: malaria (Plasmodium), amoebic dysentery yani pechish (Entamoeba histolytica) aur sleeping sickness (Trypanosoma).
Protists ke bare groups

items: Group Protozoa mein janwaron jaise (animal-like) protists aate hain. Yeh unicellular aur heterotrophic hain, yani apni ghiza khud nahi banate. Misaalein: Paramecium, Amoeba, Plasmodium aur Trypanosoma.

Group Algae mein podon jaise (plant-like) protists aate hain. In ki cell walls cellulose ki hoti hain, in mein chlorophyll hota hai aur yeh autotrophs hain, yani photosynthesis se apni ghiza khud banate hain. Misaalein: Euglena aur diatoms.

Groups Myxomycota aur Oomycota mein fungi jaise (fungi-like) protists aate hain. In mein hyphae jaisi banawat hoti hai aur yeh saprophytic hain, yani mari hui cheezon se ghiza lete hain. Misaalein: slime molds aur water molds.

blocks.text: 2. Kingdom Fungi

Fungi eukaryotic aur heterotrophic jandar hain jo unicellular ya multicellular ho sakte hain. In ke cells par chitin (ek polysaccharide) ki cell wall hoti hai. Fungi ghiza ek khaas tareeqe se lete hain: yeh janwaron aur kuch protists ki tarah khana nigalte (ingest) nahi, balke apne ird gird se ghiza absorb (jazb) karte hain. Misaalein: mushrooms (khumbi), rusts, smuts aur molds (phaphoond).
Kuch fungi bread, cheese aur beer banane mein istemal hote hain. Kuch dawa ke kaam aate hain, jaise penicillin, ek antibiotic jo fungus Penicillium se hasil hoti hai.
Fungi ke bare groups
Fungi ke bare groups yeh hain:

items: Zygomycota mein woh fungi aate hain jin ke hyphae mein septa (cross walls, yani andar ki deewarein) nahi hote. Misal: Rhizopus (bread mold), jo geeli bread aur phalon par ugta hai.
Ascomycota fungi ke sab se bare groups mein se hai. In ke hyphae septate hain, yani un mein septa hote hain. Misaalein: aam molds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora aur yeasts (khameer).
Basidiomycota mein septate hyphae wale fungi aate hain. Misaalein: mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi, bracket ya shelf fungi, rusts aur smuts.

blocks.title: Kitab mein hijje
blocks.text: Kitab ki heading “Makro Groups of Fungi” chhapi hai; is ka matlab “Major Groups of Fungi” hai. Isi tarah “Major Groups or Protists” ka matlab “Major Groups of Protists” hai.

Fungi ki taqreeban 100,000 maloom species hain. Bohat se Ascomycetes lichens (fungus aur alga ki saajhedaari) mein milte hain; lichens banane wali zyada tar fungi Ascomycetes hi hoti hain. Kuch Ascomycetes mycorrhizae (fungus aur podon ki jaron ki saajhedaari) mein milte hain.
3. Kingdom Plantae

Is kingdom mein plants (poday) aate hain: eukaryotic, multicellular jandar jin ki cell walls cellulose ki hoti hain. Yeh autotrophic hain aur photosynthesis se apni ghiza banate hain. Tamam poday embryo se develop hote hain. Misaalein: mosses (kaai), ferns, conifers aur flowering plants (phool wale poday).
Podon ke bare groups
Podon ke do bare groups hain:

items: Nonvascular plants ya bryophytes mein conducting tissues (xylem aur phloem, yani paani aur ghiza le jaane wale tissues) nahi hote. Misaalein: liverworts, hornworts aur mosses.
Vascular plants mein conducting tissues hote hain. Yeh do qisam ke hain: seedless plants (beej ke baghair, jaise ferns) aur seed plants (beej wale, jaise conifers aur flowering plants).

blocks.alt: Nau podon ke khaake teen qataaron mein. Nonvascular plants: moss (gaddi jaisa hara guchha, dandiyon par capsules), liverwort (chapta, do-shaakha thallus jis par gemma cups hain) aur hornwort (chapta thallus jis se seeng jaise sporophytes nikalte hain). Seed plants, gymnosperms: sago palm, pine, Cedrus aur Ginkgo biloba. Seed plants, phool wale podey: Capsicum (laal mirch) aur mustard (sarson, peele phool).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.8: Kingdom Plantae ke bare groups (kitab ki Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; gymnosperms wali qataar ka sahih unwan).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wali qataar ke podon (moss, liverwort, hornwort) mein xylem aur phloem nahi hote. Beech wali qataar ke poday (sago palm, pine, Cedrus, Ginkgo biloba) gymnosperms hain: in ke beej hote hain lekin phal ke andar nahi. Neeche wali qataar (capsicum yani shimla mirch, mustard yani sarson) flowering plants hain, jin ke beej phal ke andar hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein beech wali qataar (sago palm, pine, Cedrus, Ginkgo biloba) ke neeche 'Seedless vascular plants' likha hai. Yeh ghalat hai: yeh sab beej (seed) wale podey hain, jinhein gymnosperms kehte hain; in ke beej phal ke andar nahi hote. Seedless vascular plants ki misaal ferns hain, jo is tasveer mein nahi hain. Is liye hamare khaake mein beech wali qataar 'Seed plants: gymnosperms' aur neeche wali (capsicum, mustard) 'Seed plants: flowering plants' hai.

blocks.caption: Teen domains ke kingdoms ki pehchaan wali khasoosiyat

blocks.text: Table ke har column ko ek kingdom ka khaka samajh kar parhein. Kitab Bacteria aur Archaea dono ko purane kingdom Monera ke neeche dikhati hai, kyunke five-kingdom system mein tamam prokaryotes Monera mein thay.
4. Kingdom Animalia

Eukaryotes ki is kingdom mein janwar (animals) aate hain, jo eukaryotic, multicellular aur heterotrophic hain. Yeh embryo se develop hote hain. Yeh khana nigalte (ingest) hain aur apne jism ke andar digest (hazam) karte hain.
Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Protista: unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya simple multicellular eukaryotes; janwaron jaise protozoa, podon jaise algae, aur fungi jaise slime molds aur water molds.
Fungi: chitin ki cell wall; ghiza nigalte nahi, jazb karte hain; Zygomycota (septa nahi), Ascomycota aur Basidiomycota (septate hyphae).
Plantae: cellulose ki wall, photosynthetic, embryo se develop; nonvascular bryophytes aur vascular plants (seedless aur seed plants).
Animalia: multicellular, heterotrophic, embryo se develop, khana nigal kar andar digest karte hain.
Sirf Animalia mein cell wall nahi hoti; Fungi ki wall chitin ki aur Plantae ki cellulose ki hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek multicellular eukaryote apne ird gird se ghiza jazb karta hai aur us ki cell walls chitin ki hain. Yeh kis kingdom mein hai, aur sirf cell wall dekh kar kaun si doosri kingdoms khaarij ho jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Fungi hai. Chitin ki wall Plantae ko khaarij karti hai, jin ki walls cellulose ki hoti hain, aur Animalia ko bhi, jin mein cell wall hoti hi nahi.
